title: Lazarus named so the deed is shown true
english: …in these things? But, someone says, when he names the appellation Lazarus, it truly happened and was done. Why did he not say a certain poor man, but Lazarus? So that by the name he might show these things were done in experience and truth. Solution: The judgment, and so on. 9. If Hosea the prophet took a harlot wife and…
translator_notes: True OET from PG 77 / Vat. gr. 447 Greek; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.

title: Hosea’s wife and Melchizedek’s origin
english: …begot children from her in deed and energy, or does he speak things understood prophetically? If Melchizedek is not simply a man nor a spirit, but a man having no beginning of generation from humans, but newly created by God. CYR. title: Look to Hosea and Genesis on Melchizedek
english: …prophet Hosea, and in the book on Genesis much examination is found concerning Melchizedek; and it is open to your piety to meet with the books and take from there the sense of what was said on each.
